title: Happy snake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <style>
      .s1 { fill: #3dcc5c; }
      .s2 { fill: #2fa84a; }
      .s3 { fill: #7be08c; }
      .tongue { fill: #ff5c7a; }
      .eye { fill: #1a1a2e; }
      .pupil { fill: #ffe94d; }
      .blush { fill: #ff8c9e; opacity: 0.7; }
    </style>
  </defs>
  <!-- Body curve -->
  <path class='s1' d='M20,80 C20,60 35,55 45,55 C60,55 70,65 70,75 C70,85 60,90 50,90 C40,90 32,85 32,78 C32,72 38,68 45,68 C52,68 58,73 58,78 C58,83 53,86 48,86' stroke='#2fa84a' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <path class='s3' d='M20,80 C20,62 34,57 44,57' stroke='#7be08c' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M70,75 C70,84 62,88 53,88' stroke='#7be08c' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='78' rx='14' ry='11' class='s1'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='76' rx='11' ry='6' class='s3' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='17' cy='75' r='3.5' class='eye'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='75' r='3.5' class='eye'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='75' r='1.8' class='pupil'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='75' r='1.8' class='pupil'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='73.5' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='73.5' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M18,81 Q22,86 28,81' stroke='#2fa84a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Tongue -->
  <path d='M22,83 L22,88 L19,91 M22,88 L25,91' stroke='#ff5c7a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='13' cy='80' rx='3' ry='2' class='blush'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='80' rx='3' ry='2' class='blush'/>
  <!-- Pattern spots -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='60' r='3' class='s2'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='63' r='3' class='s2'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='70' r='3' class='s2'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='78' r='3' class='s2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='3' class='s2'/>
</svg>
